title: Petachyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shekalim ch. 5, mishnah 1, as having been appointed in the Temple over the bird offerings (kinin). And it says there: "Petahiah — this is Mordechai." And why was he called Petahiah? Because he would open (poteach) matters and expound them, and he knew seventy languages.
